evidence: Committed static baseline: the frozen solution is 12 committed files (solution/solve.sh plus solution/app/**); no build step, code generation, download or lockfile-free npm install happens at solve time. solve.sh only refuses to run while the DB is held open, does `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` and deletes the disposable app.db/-wal/-shm under /app, so every installation starts from the same committed bytes and an empty database. Pinned dependencies: package.json pins express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 exactly; both images install the same exact versions globally (environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile `npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1`) and solve.sh installs nothing. Deterministic seed: src/db.js:37 reads seed_data.json from beside the module (not /assets, not the network); src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c80...3740). seedIfEmpty (db.js:61-86) runs only when the users table is empty, inserts users/jobs/applications/messages/reads/notes in file order with seed ids (USR-*, JOB-*, APP-*), the fixed application created_at literal '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' (db.js:75) and the seed's own fixed message/note created_at strings; message rowids follow file order, and read markers resolve via read_count to those rowids, so the same rows result every run. No random id, wall-clock value or fetch touches seeded data. No boot-time fetch: bootstrap.js only listens and proxies to a 127.0.0.1 worker; index.js makes no outbound request; the browser fetch() in app.js:29 is same-origin API only; index.html loads no off-origin resource. Runtime nondeterminism is confined to user-created records, which no criterion pins: uid() = crypto.randomBytes(3) for new JOB-/APP- ids (index.js:60,208,226), session tokens (index.js:88), and now() wall-clock created_at for new sessions/activity/notes/messages/applications (index.js:59). All ordering that graded views use is by id/position/title (index.js:181,182,189,199,389,407,411-412), not wall clock; the candidate list orders by created_at,id (index.js:173) where seeded rows share the fixed timestamp and new rows are necessarily later. Timestamps render with toLocaleString('en-GB',{timeZone:'UTC'}) (app.js:21), so display does not depend on the container TZ. Grep of every judge.toml/prompt.md/app_context.md found no generated id, date literal or clock value that criteria pin. The brief and rules contain no date/age-based business rule; the only time figure is the 15-second live-update latency, which is a liveness bound, not a pinned value. Hashes: all 12 frozen solution files recompute to the matching_source_files hashes in raw-evidence-index.json, and the three cited artifacts (workspace.cjs 3442c035..., results/workspace.json 4ead3c40..., results/server.log 6752f461...) recompute to their indexed hashes. That scripted golden run (not a judge/Oracle run) includes 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' and 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding', consistent with the source reading. Colderwater lessons bearing on this row: #19/#21 (golden harness rerun on current bytes; no rerun-for-roll) satisfied by hash-matched 8 Oct scripted run; #13 (no public internet dependency) - the reference has none; #15 restart durability - no reseed on restart (db.js:62) while solve.sh gives a clean baseline. Other lessons (brief voice, weights, judge prompt steps, timing races) do not bear on reference determinism. Adversarial: a conforming alternative app using its own id scheme, UUIDs or different timestamps would not be failed by this row's concern because no criterion pins ids or times; a broken reference variant (e.g. seeding with Math.random ids or Date.now created_at, or fetching seed at boot) is absent here. Residual Note-level observations, not defects: new-record ids are random (3 bytes; a PK collision would surface as a 500 on one insert, vanishingly unlikely in a single grading session) and transitive npm dependencies of the pinned packages are resolved at image build without a lockfile (image pinning is owned by deterministic/row-47 checks). Scope: source/hash review plus existing scripted evidence; no new runtime run and no configured judge/Oracle score is claimed.
